prompt_common_prefix: Minimalist hand-drawn cartoon doodle, clean black ink outlines, flat colours. The reference image shows two neighbouring drawings side by side (left = earlier, right = later); draw ONE new single drawing that is exactly halfway between them, copying their exact line style, proportions, size and placement.
prompt_common_suffix: A single full frame, not a comparison, not two panels. no text, no writing, no numbers, no paper edges, no borders
reference_note: Only the first attempts of 12_16 and 32_33 used the original JPEG ref_txt verbatim. Copying the JPEG base64 by hand repeatedly failed (long runs of 'A' miscounted -> 'Invalid base64 image'), so all other calls used a WebP re-encode of the same composite extra/refs/r{a}_{b}.jpg: extra/refs/r{a}_{b}.webp.txt (q60/q40) or, for 67_68 retry, 68_69, 69_70, 72_73, 85_88, a 480x157 downscale extra/refs/r{a}_{b}.small.txt.

entries.prompt: Plain white background, no colour. Only the head of the cartoon man (oval face, neat dense scribbled dark hair cap, dot eyes, u-nose, small smile, rounded ears, hint of neck), turning halfway from three-quarter-right to front view, ~1/4 frame height, centre ~40% across and 1/3 down.
entries.note: Attempt 1 (rejected_12_16_1) had spiky hair and too-small head; retry matches style, position halfway; head still slightly small.

entries.prompt: White background, B&W line art. Full-body man front view, centred, same scale; knees very slightly bent, feet apart, arms slightly away from body, eyebrows starting to look determined, small smile.
entries.note: First call failed with provider error (not charged).

entries.prompt: White background, B&W. Full-body man, knees half bent, torso leaning forward, head lowered, arms hanging out and starting to swing back, determined frown.
entries.note: Two calls rejected as Invalid base64 (JPEG ref copy errors); third used a WebP re-encode of the same composite. Figure ~10% smaller than neighbours.

entries.prompt: White background, B&W. Man in squat slightly deeper than left, torso forward, both arms swung back halfway to straight back, determined frown.
entries.note: Attempt 1 (rejected_32_33_1) had a different, thicker style; retry matches.

entries.prompt: White background, B&W. Man springing up from crouch: legs almost straight, toes leaving ground, arms swinging forward/up, face turning happy.

entries.prompt: White background, B&W. Man in mid-air jump, arms straight up, knees halfway lifted toward chest, speed lines below.

Sky gradient white top to blue lower half, two small clouds appearing. B&W man in spread-eagle star, tilting slightly right.

entries.prompt: Sky: white haze top quarter fading to blue, clouds lower-left and right. B&W man falling spread-eagle tilted right, shirt hem fluttering.
Full blue sky, small clouds with speed streaks. B&W man spread-eagle tilted right.
Full blue sky with clouds. Colour flooding in: pale light-peach skin and light-brown hair, shirt/trousers/shoes still white.
Blue sky, many clouds, moderate thin speed streaks. Fully coloured man (peach skin, brown hair, red T-shirt, blue jeans, white sneakers) spread-eagle.
Blue sky, fewer clouds and faint streaks, top of big cloud rising at bottom edge. Coloured man spread-eagle tilted right.
Blue sky, big cloud top at bottom. Coloured man rotating upright feet-first, arms out wide and slightly up, legs together pointing down.
entries.note: Pose closer to the later drawing; big cloud slightly larger than neighbours.

entries.prompt: Blue sky, big cloud at bottom. Coloured man about to land: knees half bent and lifting, arms diagonal up/out.
Blue sky with small clouds. Man's bottom sinking into big cloud which squashes wider, legs forward, arms up wide, small puffs at cloud ends.
Man sits sunk into flattened cloud, legs forward, arms out at shoulder height, medium puffs bursting from cloud ends.
Cloud springing back up with side puffs; man bouncing up off it, knees pulled up, arms raised.
Man dropping back onto wide cloud, bottom touching top, legs forward, arms lowering to chest height.
Cloud just beginning to tip (left end slightly raised); man leaning back, one arm lifting, surprised round mouth.
Cloud tipping at moderate diagonal like a slide; large man (~40% frame height) sliding toward lower-right end, arms up, shocked face, speed lines.

entries.prompt: Blue sky, clouds, wide grass field. Man sitting centred, head turned to his right, happy; small white duck (orange beak/feet) waddling right at ~85% across, mid-step.
